title_en: Table 3.5: Registered Population by Age Group (Under 18 and 18+), by Island, 2025 (as of 31 December 2025)
notes: Dhafthar in Male' is a special registry where people who have migrated and who have lived for 5 years are registered.

Definition: The concept of registered population is different from enumerated. In census people are counted at the place where they are residing at the census reference time. A person can be registered in one island and be living in another island
columns: 18 years & above Registered Population - Both Sexes
